solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Balloon, first of many captured by radar image

indicators.note: the letter is held inside the radar image, as a prisoner is captured

parts.note: a blip is the spot a target makes on a radar screen

indicators.note: first of picks out only the opening letter of the word many

explanation.surface: A balloon shows up on radar, with the first of many being picked up.
explanation.definitionFit: A blimp is a non-rigid airship, a kind of large gas-filled balloon.

clue.text: Flatter round base of aquatic plant

indicators.note: round says the flattering phrase surrounds the next letter

parts.note: to butter up is to flatter someone

indicators.note: base of in a down clue picks the bottom, last letter of aquatic

explanation.surface: Flattery surrounds the base of a water plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aquatic plant' looks like the definition; only 'plant' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: The buttercup is a common yellow-flowered meadow plant.

clue.text: How movie ends is silly

parts.note: how something ends can be answered 'in an' something

indicators.note: ends picks the final letter of the word movie

explanation.surface: Someone complains that the way a film finishes is silly.
explanation.walkthrough: The word 'movie' ends in an E: 'How movie ends' reads as IN AN plus E.
explanation.definitionFit: Inane means pointless or foolish, a direct synonym.

clue.text: A way through unspoilt meadow

indicators.note: through says the way passes into the middle of the unspoilt word

parts.note: pure means unspoilt or untainted
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A path runs through an unspoilt meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasture is grassland for grazing animals, essentially a meadow.

clue.text: Be persuaded to visit

definitions.meaning: to change your mind and agree after argument
to drop in at someone's home

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to be won over to a view and to call on someone casually.

clue.text: Private room near top of tower

parts.note: close means near

indicators.note: top of in a down clue means the first letter of tower

explanation.surface: A private room is located near the top of a tower.
explanation.definitionFit: A closet is a small private room or cupboard, an older sense.

clue.text: A figure of speech to hamper translation

indicators.note: translation implies the letters are turned into a different form

explanation.surface: A figure of speech that obstructs translation.
explanation.definitionFit: A metaphor is a figure of speech describing one thing as another.

clue.text: Deep regret about the South invading again

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: invading puts the letter for South into the word for again

parts.note: more means again, as in once more

explanation.surface: Someone deeply regrets the South invading once more.
explanation.definitionFit: Remorse is deep regret or guilt for a wrong done.

clue.text: In doubt, new curate about new home

indicators.note: about puts the rearranged curate around the abbreviation for new
new suggests the word curate is remade in a fresh order

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A new curate is unsure about his new home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges CURATE into UCERTA, and 'about' wraps that round N.
explanation.definitionFit: Uncertain means not sure, the state of being in doubt.

clue.text: Wife in small boat bringing gift for new husband

indicators.note: in places the letter for wife inside the small boat

parts.note: a dory is a small flat-bottomed boat

explanation.surface: A wife in a little boat brings her husband a present.
explanation.definitionFit: A dowry is property a bride brings to her husband at marriage.

clue.text: Without one, coaches left ship

indicators.note: without tells us the numeral for one is dropped from the railway coaches

parts.note: railway coaches coupled together make trains
I is the Roman numeral for one
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Coaches departed by sea instead, minus one passenger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' removes I from TRAINS to leave TRANS. 'ship' is a verb here, not the noun it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: To ship goods is to transport them, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Parrot beginning to mimic a crow's cry

indicators.note: beginning to points at only the opening letter of the word mimic

parts.note: caw is the harsh call of a crow

explanation.surface: A parrot starts copying the call of a crow.
explanation.definitionFit: The macaw is a large, brightly coloured tropical parrot.

clue.text: Carry out guillotine

definitions.meaning: to perform or accomplish a task
to put to death by beheading

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to accomplish a plan and to kill someone as a legal penalty.

clue.text: Paint a picture of harbour fish

parts.note: a port is a harbour for ships
the ray is a flat cartilaginous fish

explanation.surface: An artist paints a fish caught in the harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: To depict someone in words or art is to describe or represent them, a synonym.

clue.text: Fellow attached to the Spanish church

parts.note: a chap is an informal word for a man or fellow
el is the Spanish masculine word for the

explanation.surface: A man joins the Spanish church.
explanation.definitionFit: A small place of worship, often within a larger church or for a nonconformist congregation.

clue.text: Finished among a group left behind

indicators.note: among says the finished word goes in the midst of the group

parts.note: a band is a group
done means finished

explanation.surface: A finished musician is left behind by the group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'among' splits the four letters of the group so that the word for finished sits inside them, before their last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Abandoned means deserted or left behind.

clue.text: Outlook, sort cafe developed

indicators.note: developed suggests the letters have been worked into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone describes a cafe's outlook as having been developed.
explanation.definitionFit: The outlook, as in a weather outlook, is a prediction of what is to come.

clue.text: Dicky berated, biting ends of dinky toy

indicators.note: biting has the rearranged letters take the dinky ends inside them
dicky means shaky or faulty, so the word berated is broken up
ends of picks the first and last letters of dinky

explanation.surface: Someone called Dicky scolds, nipping the ends off a small toy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' looks like a man's name but means shaky, signalling the rearrangement into TEDBEAR; 'biting' then takes the dinky ends inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A teddy bear is a soft stuffed toy bear.

clue.text: Group of characters in sacred river needing help

parts.note: Alph is the sacred river of Coleridge's Kubla Khan
to abet is to help

explanation.surface: A group of people stand in a holy river needing aid.
explanation.definitionFit: The alphabet is the set of letters used to write a language.

clue.text: Work willingly with others in activity ahead of dance

indicators.note: ahead of places the activity in front of the dance

parts.note: play is recreational activity
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Someone cooperates in a game before a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom from sport meaning to cooperate rather than obstruct.

clue.text: Marsh bird from intensely cold North

parts.note: bitter weather is very cold

explanation.surface: A marsh bird from the freezing North.
explanation.definitionFit: The bittern is a heron-like wading bird of reedbeds and marshes.

clue.text: Copied record, single, inside

indicators.note: inside places the word for single within the record

parts.note: CD is a compact disc, a type of record
lone means single or solitary

explanation.surface: A record single was copied with something inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'single' wants to be a pop record, but it means LONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloned things are exact genetic or technical copies of an original.

clue.text: Young child enthralled by stories? That's an understatement

indicators.note: enthralled by means held inside the stories

parts.note: lies are stories, as in telling stories
a tot is a small child

explanation.surface: A toddler gripped by tales; calling it that is an understatement.
explanation.definitionFit: Litotes is a figure of speech using understatement, such as 'not bad' for good.

clue.text: Hit by the Parisian band

parts.note: to bang is to hit
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A French band gets hit.
explanation.definitionFit: A bangle is a rigid ornamental band worn on the wrist.

clue.text: Attempt, with wife, to share expenses equally

parts.note: a go is a try or attempt
'my old dutch' is Cockney slang for a wife

explanation.surface: Someone tries, with their wife, to split the bill.
explanation.walkthrough: DUTCH for wife comes from Cockney London slang ('my old Dutch', short for duchess).
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for each person paying their own share of a meal or outing.

clue.text: Good scope for stable lad

parts.note: room means scope, as in room for improvement

explanation.surface: Plenty of scope for a young stable worker.
explanation.definitionFit: A groom is someone who looks after horses in a stable.

clue.text: PM in car spy sabotaged

parts.note: auto is short for automobile, a car

indicators.note: sabotaged suggests the word spy has been wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: A Prime Minister was in a car a spy had sabotaged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'PM' looks like the Prime Minister but is post-mortem; 'sabotaged' rearranges SPY to PSY.
explanation.definitionFit: A post-mortem examination of a body is the same as this medical procedure.

clue.text: Religious set's guide

parts.note: pi is informal for pious or religious
a lot is a set or group of items

explanation.surface: A guide for a religious group.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot steers or guides, as a ship's pilot through a harbour.

clue.text: Big cat needs power to make sudden swoop

indicators.note: needs means lacks, so the letter for power is missing from the swoop

parts.note: a pounce is a sudden spring or swoop
P is the abbreviation for power in physics

explanation.surface: A big cat needs strength to launch a sudden attack.
explanation.walkthrough: The cat lacks P, the extra it would need to become a POUNCE.
explanation.definitionFit: The ounce is another name for the snow leopard, one of the big cats.

clue.text: A revolver held by beautiful girl in game

indicators.note: held by puts the gun inside the beautiful girl

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful woman
gat is old slang for a gun or revolver

explanation.surface: A gangster's moll holds a revolver during a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Bagatelle is a table game in which balls are struck into holes, a forerunner of pinball.

clue.text: Parisian salesgirl in motorway eating area

parts.note: the M1, Britain's first motorway, is written MI by crosswords
a dinette is a small dining area

explanation.surface: A Parisian shop girl in a motorway service cafe.
explanation.definitionFit: A midinette is a young Parisian shop assistant, especially in fashion.

clue.text: Instrument in transit, a radiometer

indicators.note: in signals that the answer is contained within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A scientific instrument travels in transit with a radiometer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Instrument' suggests the radiometer, but it is a musical one.
explanation.definitionFit: The sitar is a long-necked Indian stringed musical instrument.
